exceptions.title: does not throw in production when the same element is registered under multiple ids
exceptions.reason: The case needs a production build. Vitest sets `process.env.NODE_ENV` when it transforms a file for a browser, so only the Node project can change it.

exceptions.title: uses the default popup id as the popup id
exceptions.reason: The case asserts the default popup id while no popup element exists. Vase UI gives no id then (`VUE-73`). The block `VUE-73: the popup id is the id of the popup element` tests the popup id and the lone trigger with a popup element.

exceptions.title: associates a lone trigger with the popup id unless the popup opened without a trigger
exceptions.reason: The case asserts the default popup id while no popup element exists. Vase UI gives no id then (`VUE-73`). The block `VUE-73: the popup id is the id of the popup element` tests the popup id and the lone trigger with a popup element.
